## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? Keep this concise. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Release or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run knip`
- [ ] `bun run build` (Chrome and Firefox)
- [ ] `bun run zip` (when packaging is affected)
- [ ] Manually checked in a browser (when UI behavior is affected)

## Changeset

- [ ] Added a changeset for user-visible changes
- [ ] No changeset needed (CI/docs-only)

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and easy to review.
- [ ] Non-trivial behavior has tests.
- [ ] No secrets or private keys are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated.
